info.title: Madrigal public Gateway API
info.description: Native HTTP contracts for four independent service modules. Internal service routes are excluded. Decimal strings preserve offsets and analysis field values. Results view=messages preserves message grouping; view=checks filters and paginates individual checks; omitted view retains the legacy flattened response.
